notes.title: LeaderBoard has been added. (V1.04A)
notes.notes:
The latest version of the game (1.04A) now has leader-boards for each level . Now we can see some friendly competition for the lowest times. Check it out here :
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/575400/leaderboards/1693485/

Please update to the latest version and "Reset All" in the Level Menu or do a better time than your existing to see yourself in the leaderboard.
